No table-shaped or stage-header-block-shaped unit occurred in this range (confirmed by reading the full diff; DOC-UPDATER's own note that only three of the four shapes were exercised here is correct). (4) `git diff --stat main..HEAD -- CLAUDE.md README.md docs/migration/README.md` returned empty -- confirmed untouched. (5) Scope discipline: `git diff --stat main..HEAD` shows exactly four changed paths -- docs/requirements.yaml, this run's own handoffs/WF02-REQ257-20260905/{step00-git-setup.json,step01-doc-updater.json}, and handoffs/registry.json (bookkeeping). `git diff -U0` hunk line numbers all fall inside the pre-edit REQ-189(10039)..REQ-243(14310, excluded) span; no hunk touches REQ-001..REQ-188 or REQ-243 onward (sibling-owned chunks). (6) REQ-237's out-of-sequence inclusion: independently re-derived its physical position via `grep -n '^  - id: REQ-24[0-9]\b'` and `grep -n '^  - id: REQ-237\b'` against the current tree -- REQ-242 at line 14265, REQ-237 at line 14301, REQ-243 at line 14366: REQ-237 is confirmed physically between REQ-242 and REQ-243, out of numeric sequence, exactly as DOC-UPDATER reported. (7) Idempotency: ran a file-wide scan for two consecutive 'PROVENANCE (historical' lines -- zero duplicates found anywhere in the file (not just this run's range). (8) YAML validity: `python -c "import yaml; yaml.safe_load(open('docs/requirements.yaml', encoding='utf-8'))"` parsed cleanly against the current working tree, 241 top-level requirement entries -- matches DOC-UPDATER's own reported count.
